cases.description: bind the published 72-source, 9-ROM, 2-header closure to the exact 74-field and 67-port contracts
preserve kind, mask, router sequence validity, config_take and all three clip masks with line provenance
kind 3, 4 and 8 with zero data/sequence and invalid sequence are not promoted to real events
kind 1 and 2 rows sharing one valid router sequence remain two ordered stages
router sequence equality alone cannot populate independent input-plan apply_event_seq
a declaration-only association and formatted hash cannot supply apply_event_seq without reading and verifying the plan body and actual acceptance evidence
advance_frame_req_id remains a request tag while FRAME F comes only from frame_tick
a nonzero partial 4-bit mask does not establish all-four-lane advance
an X-bearing advance mask is preserved with an explicit pending reason
an exact four-bit binary 1111 representation establishes all-four-lane advance
router sequence zero remains a legal first accepted cause when its validity bit is one
missing one of the published 74 fields is rejected
per-row source line, cycle, epoch and phase must match the raw row
substituting a schema while retaining its role is rejected
X/null apply and audio stability values remain pending instead of becoming zero or valid
consume Role A M3_R7A_C9_PUBLIC_ROW_V1 rows mechanically, preserve all 74 field values and upstream evidence, auto-bind the input file identity, and leave plan association pending
reject a Role A envelope that loses any one of the 74 normalized fields
